verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own docs describe Workload Identity Federation as giving on-premises or multicloud workloads access to Google Cloud resources through federated identities instead of a service account key, which is the core of the story. The pack has only this single summary line, so the CI-specific OIDC flow, short-lived token issuance, and end-to-end documentation are not shown. missing for 10: explicit short-lived credential and token-lifetime documentation, CI-specific OIDC setup (e.g. CI provider integration), end-to-end walkthrough evidence, policy to block long-lived key creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
